list: The official 55 PS5 trophies, as published by PlayStation and tracked by Exophase and PSNProfiles (2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; every guide below is written for this entry and names its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum needs no work of its own: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Plan the whole run around the two long poles — the story and the 100% checklist behind A Long Road — and this one closes the list by itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks simply by playing through the start of Chapter 1, and chapter-linked trophies can land at the start of the following chapter rather than on a final cutscene. The game has no mission replay, but story trophies like this one cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Before you close the chapter out, do two things: park a manual save near the chapter's start, and take Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears once Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after this chapter's mission Breakfast Run, and that is when the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and most free-roam systems become available, so the list widens quickly from here.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. During this chapter watch for Yago's timed street race (Race Against Yago, marked with an hourglass): it counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so save first and run it when it appears instead of leaving it behind.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Bank vault robberies open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of this chapter, which is the gateway to Maximum Withdrawal and the easiest setup for Hot Together.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The Gold story trophy, awarded for completing the final mission. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission. Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, so nothing else on the list needs to be rushed before this point.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Finishing it is also the moment character switching opens, so several partner and free-roam trophies only become possible from here on. No optional objective or medal is attached to it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. It is awarded for finishing the mission as the story presents it; despite the name, no separate free-roam bank robbery is required for this one.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it cannot be missed: complete the mission as it arrives in the main story and it unlocks.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. Complete the mission as part of the main story; there are no side conditions, medals or optional objectives attached to it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is separate from the free-roam airport trophy Catch Me If You Can, which you can earn at the same airport whenever you like after it opens up.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission during the main story and the trophy unlocks; no optional conditions are attached to it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The Gold for 100% Completion, and the longest job on the list. The checklist itself only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. Its bars sit above several trophy minimums: 300 stunts where Cunning Stunts asks 250, 70 of the 80 Challenges where One Last Thing asks 50, 200 of 277 base vehicles where Whip It Good asks 100, plus all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations. Guides put the full Platinum run at roughly 200 hours.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total. They are spread across the whole state, so work them into exploration instead of grinding one spot — and keep going afterwards if you are chasing A Long Road, whose checklist asks for 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types once. This is a sampler, not a mastery test: start one activity of every kind — races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling and the rest — and the trophy is done. It doubles as a tour of the systems the deeper trophies are built on.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the game's two ranges. Golds reward score and accuracy rather than raw speed, so learn each challenge's target pattern and replay it until the medal sticks — range challenges can be retried as often as you need.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. You need one win per location, not a sweep of every race at it, so tick each location off as new areas open and come back to any stubborn course later with a better-tuned drone.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeating the same race does not add to the count. Races unlock through the racing strands as the story opens the map, so work through each new race once as it appears and the total builds alongside your Strangers & Freaks progress.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this pairs naturally with Master of None: learn the reeling rhythm on ordinary catches first, then take on Cal's challenge once your timing is reliable.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any of the four in-game arcade titles counts. Find a cabinet, then play a full game through to completion rather than quitting mid-run, and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's side storyline. Work through Andy's strand whenever its markers appear and the trophy lands on the strand's last job. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it is rewarded with this trophy instead.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's side storyline. Follow Kenton's strand to its end and the trophy unlocks on the last job. It is one of the 28 trophies PlayStation keeps hidden until earned, so its absence from your list is normal.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's side storyline. Billy's strand, like Andy's and Tyrone's, carries its own trophy and does not count toward the 8 strands that Strangers & Freaks asks for.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts: the strands for Andy, Billy and Tyrone are excluded because they carry their own trophies, so check this trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Yago's timed Chapter 3 race strand does count — run it when it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's side storyline. Clear Randy's markers as they appear across the map and the trophy unlocks on the strand's final job.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's side storyline. Tyrone's strand is one of the three named strands that does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it is rewarded here instead.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 in all. Spots appear as purple icons when you are close, and outdoor spots can count for both characters if your partner meditates there with you. One spot is missable: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 vanishes when the chapter ends, so do it before finishing Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops. It is the only missable trophy the published guides report.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and works through target decks that point you at specific animals; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the questline asks for.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across the whole state, so treat this as a long-haul collection: sweep cards up as you explore each new area instead of hunting them all at the end, and use the in-game collection screen to see which set is closest to finished.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations around Leonida. Weave the scans into ordinary travel rather than making special trips: scanning traffic with the same app also counts vehicles toward Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, out of the 80 the game tracks under Progress > Challenges. Many of them complete on their own as you play, so check the Challenges screen before grinding any single one — and remember the 100% checklist asks for 70 before you stop at 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. The natural setup is a bank vault job: vaults hand you 4 stars immediately, and if your partner is along, escaping that same heat earns this trophy too. It only pops once you have fully left the red heat zone, not merely the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner in first, then chain the robberies while the police are still actively chasing you: if the stars fade into the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop, so give it a moment before robbing a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and every new model adds to the total. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this one pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim triggered with L3 and R3 while aiming. Build the meter first — landing fish adds roughly 10% per catch — then pick a packed group such as the guards at a gang's illegal operation, bring an assault rifle, and use adrenaline to stretch the Focus window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count — and take off in it. The jets at gates E3 and E4 are known to work. Save first, because the police respond fast, and keep flying: the trophy is delayed and pops roughly a kilometre out from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The joke description gives it away: a Rhino is a military tank, and the trophy is about getting into one. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys. Save before you break in, then drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. These robberies open with Yasmani's Chapter 3 job Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which hands you the Snap Gun: use it on the store's locked back door, because kicking the door in trips the alarm. Inside, find the note carrying the safe code in the back room, empty the safe and leave unseen — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target. If you are spotted, reload and retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard holds it open. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone, and expect an instant 4-star Wanted Level — which also sets up Hot Together. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks appear in free roam as they move money around the map: hit one, take the cash, break line of sight, and stay clear of the red heat zone until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: every area of the state has to be visited at least once. It pairs naturally with the card, stunt and meditation hunts — sweep each region properly as the story opens it, then use the map to find the pockets you never entered.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation for each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this trophy lands early on that road; the guards posted at an operation also make a handy crowd for Gunslinger's Combat Focus test.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is one of the list's one-off moment trophies rather than a challenge: head to Ocean Beach, order the cocktail where drinks are served, and take in the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: get into a car sitting inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass. It is a one-off free-roam feat, so any showroom with a car on the floor and a window to aim at will do.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: play a game of bowling at that specific alley. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so the visit can double as your bowling tick for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The cryptic description points at the gym: this pops when Jason and Lucia have both reached maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner alongside you — the partner trains too — until both characters' Strength is maxed out.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: PlayStation tracks a count of 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies, fights and other criminal choices feed it as you play, so it fills up without a dedicated grind — just check the counter late in a completion run in case it lags behind.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description — 'Second time's the charm' — points to succeeding at something on the second attempt. No published guide pins it to one named event, so the honest approach is to let retries happen naturally instead of reloading at the first failure, and to revisit any failed activity and complete it on a second attempt if this has not popped late in the run.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is the list's mystery trophy: hidden on PlayStation until earned, and its description only reacts to the event instead of explaining it. Exploration is the method — the same roaming that fills The Goodtime State — and the trackers named in this trophy's sources are where a confirmed trigger will surface first.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, use a melee attack to knock a pedestrian down, bowling-style. Pick a quiet street and a slow pass so the swing connects cleanly without escalating into a chase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; selling them on to your contacts is what launders them, and the total is cumulative across the whole run, so feed every marked bill you pick up into the laundry instead of spending it.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, vehicle work, food — so it arrives naturally over a long run; property and garage spending late in the game is the big-ticket shortcut.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the eight garages sold through the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost roughly $160,000, and garages the story hands you do not count. Buy them before grinding On the Spot, because every registered car needs a free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens with the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses and choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars at a Pay 'n' Spray fitted with a standard tracker. Every car needs a free garage space, so sort Little Boxes first and register cheap cars.
